release_evidence.android: Verified presence baseline v0.11.3-rc.17; current main also includes later reader-opening/refresh fixes and the unpublished preview-version policy below. These later changes are not attributed to rc.17.
release_evidence.xteink: Verified presence baseline xteink-v2.0.0.373+bookorbit.1-rc3. Current implementation replaces the OTA opt-in with Stable / RC / Preview channels based on booksync_version.

constraints.qualification: Latest completed successful xteink.yml run observed at audit start; newer runs were still running. Compiler static RAM is not runtime free heap. No runtime low-water or PSRAM consumption measurement in these build summaries.

costs.cost: ~9.6 KB flash historical estimate; current X3 delta unmeasured. The old 7.7 KB gate margin is obsolete; 54,065 bytes now merits a fresh fit check.
16 KiB task stack plus EPUB, Wi-Fi and TLS allocations. X3 cannot keep TLS beside open book.
16 KiB task stack in PSRAM on hardware; catalog JSON allocations in PSRAM; reply cap 512 KiB and index cap 128 KiB are bounds, not measured live usage.
500 candidate IDs, up to 4000 exclusion IDs; decode buffers/ID arrays use PSRAM. Flash delta unmeasured.

costs.feature: X3 TLS arena and minimum free heap
costs.cost: 32 KiB TLS arena; TLS free floor 35,000 bytes, contiguous block 24,576 bytes. These are safety thresholds, not available RAM.

costs.feature: Other cuts (ratings, end cover, status, cache, About)
costs.cost: No isolated before/after size measurement found; do not invent savings or infer fit from disabled macros.

gaps.size: M (several controls, persistence and policy tests)
gaps.x3_fit: Subset only: sleep budget/end-sheet/copy toggle are plausible small candidates; offline and cover controls require the excluded subsystem. Measure firmware deltas.
gaps.outcome: Expose equivalent controls; Xteink sleep budget is currently 240 s rather than Android 10/15/20 s.

gaps.x3_fit: Native slot and Small/Medium/Large controls already exist, including on X3. A preset may fit; BookSync spaced formatting still needs a measured delta.
gaps.outcome: Add a single BookSync preset over existing native status-bar controls; do not rebuild controls that CrossInk already supplies.

gaps.x3_fit: Unknown; buttons can navigate categories, but text entry and extra strings have a cost.
gaps.outcome: Make equivalent settings discoverable; retain button navigation rather than require touch.

gaps.x3_fit: Android only; X3 S3 core-dump code is excluded. A C3 alternative requires separate validation.
gaps.outcome: Persist an Android crash summary that survives restart, with deduplication and no automatic remote upload.

deferred.note: Approved; X4s. X3 excluded from the current cached design; no isolated cost evidence.
Android implementation authorised 2026-11-25 on feature/0.12; Xteink follows later. Reader progress pages and Stats widgets are building; no release or device validation yet.
Verifier shipped; enforced rollout still deferred.
Future idea (maintainer ruling 2026-11-25): a BookSync server could serve cross-reader battery comparison data to other devices. On-device comparison remains Android-only by design (screen size).

limitations: Source audit, no physical device testing; Android permissions/vendor behaviour can restrict helpers.
Absence claims are based on native settings inventories and build gates; a similarly named native reader feature is not counted as an BookSync addition.
No touch requirement for parity: buttons may expose the same outcome. Lack of touch alone does not justify missing controls.
Fonts, stock Home/catalog and annotations are native integrations; only BookSync adapters, lifecycle hooks and explicit cuts are scored, not all upstream reader capabilities.
X3 upstream cuts also remove Nearby, mDNS, plugin hub and asset downloads; English-only built-in UI in platformio.local.ini. These are constraints on inherited capabilities, not BookSync features.

Server quirks motivating overlays: final progress alone may not finish a book; send-time stale pushes can win; metadata writes change file hashes. See docs/server-contract.md sections linked in the matrix notes.

post_baseline_changes.note: Android, plugin and all Xteink readers offer Stable / RC / Preview update channels. Eligibility uses the BookSync product version; upstream CrossInk labels and GitHub prerelease flags do not decide the channel. Existing opt-ins migrate to Preview; stricter channels wait for a newer allowed version. Implemented for 0.12; not yet released. See docs/design/update-channels.md.

Current main preserves reader-opening control-flow widgets, retires obsolete crawl progress and stops an old refresh before starting its replacement. These are fixes to existing reading/refresh behaviour, not features first shipped in rc.17.
